summary_en: Osaki Electric authorized acquisition of up to 2.0 million shares (4.61% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥3.0 billion through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 6, 2026 to April 30, 2027. The company also resolved to cancel 2.5 million shares (5.33% of pre-cancellation outstanding shares), with cancellation effective November 30, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decisions on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Matters Related to Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 5, 2026, Osaki Electric's board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 2.0 million shares of the company's ordinary stock, representing 4.61% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum total of ¥3.0 billion. The shares will be acquired through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 6, 2026 to April 30, 2027. The company stated that the acquisition aims to enhance capital efficiency and expand shareholder returns, and noted that this represents the third consecutive fiscal year of buyback implementation beginning in fiscal 2024.

Simultaneously, the board resolved to cancel 2.5 million shares of treasury stock, equivalent to 5.33% of outstanding shares prior to cancellation. The cancellation is scheduled to become effective on November 30, 2026, and will reduce outstanding shares from 43,380,577 (as of September 30, 2026, excluding treasury stock) to 44,417,180 shares after the cancellation takes effect. The company emphasized that treasury stock acquisition decisions are made on a continuous basis, taking into account hand-held funds, working capital, recent financial performance and share price, and balance with investment projects.
